value.rationale: The natural question is the first degree permitted by a fresh 2026 obstruction theorem, rather than an arbitrary slice. The explicit quintic construction supplies a sharp exact minimal degree and a robust parameter family with a computable strictly negative Floquet exponent, distinguishing singular invariance of the centered unit circle from true off-axis circular periodic attraction. It clarifies how coordinate-axis invariance and a geometrically separate circular attractor can coexist. The claim does not pretend to classify global dynamics or all periodic orbits.
